text:
rachel: heads up - SkylineApps (acct 2219) reported two invoices for May. One shows tax applied twice on the same line, other shows no tax. totals differ by $1,250. attaching screenshots.
tom: yikes. any job ids? @billing-bot pull run 2026-05-31-2219 and pdfs.
billing-bot: invoice-run id=2026-05-31-2219 started 2026-05-31T07:45Z completed with errors. Errors: [tax_apply:duplicate_tax_entry], [pdf_dispatch:sent_retry]. Generated PDFs: INV-2026-0531_v1.pdf (total $12,500.00), INV-2026-0531_v2.pdf (total $11,250.00).
meera: does payment capture exist and which PDF was attached?
billing-bot: payment lookup: capture id=pay_d3e4 amount_cents=1125000 attached to INV-2026-0531_v2.pdf. Portal invoice record currently shows v1 (12,500) due to later overwrite.
rachel: customer charged $11,250 per their bank, portal shows $12,500. they're worried about being overcharged. want corrected docs and an explanation for audit.
tom: likely scenario: tax calculation module retried and applied tax once during initial run and then retry logic re-applied tax on a separate path producing v1. The payment matched v2 (lower). After payment, a later publish overwrote portal with v1.
meera: action: 1) place acct 2219 on hold; 2) regen invoice with canonical tax logic and publish an invoice that matches captured payment; 3) void the incorrect portal record; 4) create a credit memo if captured amount > portal amount (not the case here) or vice versa.
legal: quick note - include short wording in correction email confirming "no additional charges were taken; the bank statement amount is the valid charge" and preserve audit trail. We may need signed acceptance if they request.
billing-bot: acct 2219 placed in billing-hold. regen job 2026-05-31-2219-rr queued with flag: tax_dedup=true, publish=false.
tom: run dry-run and post CSV. meera, include the tax module logs so we can root cause the duplicate tax entry.
billing-bot: dry-run completed. CSV shows single tax line: tax_amount=112500 (10% of subtotal 1,012,500) total=1,125,000 cents ($11,250.00). Attached logs: tax_module trace: attempt_1 applied tax to items, attempt_2 (retry handler) re-applied tax due to missing idempotency token.
meera: ok that's clear. I'll patch the tax service to require idempotency-token for apply_tax and make the retry path check for prior tax markers before applying. Also will add a pre-publish invariant: if payment_capture exists, do not overwrite published invoice record.
rachel: finance actions: void portal invoice (12,500) and publish INV-2026-0531-CORR matching capture. finance-bot create credit memo placeholder CM-2026-1044 in case refund needed.
finance-bot: created CM-2026-1044 for acct 2219. status: pending-approval. approver: tom.
tom: approved. please add analyst note: "duplicate tax application from retry path; corrected invoice issued to match capture; idempotency fix in progress."
meera: pushed hotfix to tax-service: idempotency-token enforced, retry path now checks tax_applied flag. Added unit test for duplicate-tax scenario. Also added publish-lock when payment capture exists.
legal: drafted correction email language; rachel please send with signed pdf and include tax module idempotency note for their records.
rachel: sent email with INV-2026-0531-CORR and signed note. wording: "An internal retry caused the tax line to be duplicated in one version of the invoice. We have voided the duplicate, issued a corrected invoice that matches the amount charged, and updated your portal. No additional funds were taken."
billing-bot: final status: INV-2026-0531 voided, INV-2026-0531-CORR published, CM-2026-1044 applied as placeholder then cleared (not needed). Portal and payment records reconciled.
tom: logging root cause for postmortem: missing idempotency on tax-apply endpoint and non-idempotent publish overwrote paid invoice. Recommendations: idempotency tokens for billing services, publish-lock on capture, and extended test coverage for retry scenarios.
rachel: customer confirmed receipt and audit notice satisfied. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
